verdict.rationale: Docs confirm BVNK exposes wallet, payment, quote, and transfer operations entirely through REST endpoints (e.g. POST /payment/v1/rules, /payment/v2/payins/simulation, wallet creation) with Hawk-based auth and webhooks, so chain mechanics like gas and nodes are abstracted behind conventional HTTP calls and unique blockchain addresses are auto-generated per payment. However, there is no evidence of official client libraries/SDKs in specific languages — only a mention of a CLI tool (agent-wallet-cli), not multi-language SDKs. missing for 10: documented client libraries/SDKs in multiple languages, explicit statement that gas/node management is never developer-facing.
